component.name: Clock & Timer
Reloj & Temporizador
component.summary: Always-on-top floating clock and countdown timer widget
Widget flotante de reloj y temporizador siempre visible

description.p: Clock & Timer is a modern, minimalist desktop widget designed to remain perpetually visible over any application, game, or workspace without getting buried in the background.

Reloj & Temporizador es un widget de escritorio moderno y minimalista diseñado para mantenerse siempre visible por encima de cualquier aplicación, juego o espacio de trabajo sin perderse en segundo plano.

ul.li: Always-on-top mode (pin icon) keeps time in sight at all times
Compact, frameless, and freely resizable window with dynamic typography scaling
Clock mode with 12-hour and 24-hour formats plus full localized date
Countdown timer with instant presets (+1m, +5m, +10m, +25m Pomodoro) and precise custom configuration
Auditory alarm, visual flashing indicator, and native desktop notifications upon timer completion
Intuitive opacity control via quick slider bar and instant mouse wheel scrolling
Full bilingual English and Spanish localization with persistent settings

screenshot.caption: Clock view in dark minimalist mode
Vista de reloj en modo oscuro minimalista
Countdown timer with presets and Pomodoro shortcut
Temporizador con preajustes rápidos y acceso a Pomodoro
Adjustable opacity slider
Barra deslizante de ajuste de opacidad

ul.li: Fixed historical duration accumulation bug: timer duration now cleanly clears upon countdown completion so configuring subsequent timers starts fresh
Accurate preset time addition when timer is paused or running
Polished status hint labels and active alarm state transitions

description.p: Wayland support, Ubuntu 26.04 compatibility, and fluid UI animations:

ul.li: Add automatic XWayland fallback (QT_QPA_PLATFORM="xcb;wayland") for full always-on-top window support under Wayland
Auto-detection and automatic virtualenv repair for Ubuntu 26.04 and Python 3.14 upgrades in run.sh
Smooth macOS and Ubuntu style geometry morphing and icon fade animations when toggling Mini-HUD mode
Refined Mini-HUD dimensions (230x92 px) and preserved button border-radius to prevent digit and control clipping
Fixed title bar control positioning to eliminate button jump during window transitions

description.p: Minimalist UI overhaul, System Tray, and notification fixes:

ul.li: Fix notification freeze on Linux by using normal urgency with automatic 5s dismissal
Fix notification identity and icon by passing proper app name and icon to desktop daemon
Add native Windows Action Center notifications and System Tray integration
Fix window recentering bug when toggling between standard and Mini-HUD mode
Modern minimalist icon-only controls for tabs and timer actions to eliminate text clipping
Redesigned time setup dialog with auto-repeating stepper controls and quick chip buttons
GNOME-style dual click-or-drag gesture on navigation tabs and time displays
Smooth full-window dragging from anywhere across Wayland, X11, and Windows

description.p: Mini-HUD Focus Mode and Timer Enhancements:

ul.li: New ultra-compact Mini-HUD (Focus Mode) with integrated horizontal controls
Dynamic font autoscaling for multi-hour displays
New +1h quick preset button alongside +1m, +5m, +15m, and +25m
New dedicated Clear (Trash) button to reset time to 00:00 instantly
Default starting countdown set to 00:00
Redesigned minimalist 4-button header with unified collapsible Settings panel
Always-on-top floating dialog widget with resize support
Responsive 12h/24h clock with localized calendar date
Countdown timer with presets, audio alerts, and native desktop notifications
Interactive opacity slider and mouse wheel brightness adjustment
Bilingual English and Spanish support
